criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: One dark staged night world; 7, 1 and 3 are strong. Several frames fall back on primitives or empty space: 6's empty band and abstract parts with the rail cut off; 2's lit grey ground under two primitive cylinders; 8 reads at feed size as a grey bar with one orange donut; 9's black pickup with the gauge over its cab; 4's near-plain box.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One world, one hero node, one amber accent; the value track holds dark; two devices work. 5 sits outside the world and 2's grey floor is the one value jump.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces; absences scoped and checked; context attributed by name; the grant wording matches c15. Looser than its source: the cover's 'with no server' and slide 4's 'No server in the loop' while c10 (verified, on no surface) says custom server software at a central site aggregates the nodes and a larger model builds maps; c5 scopes the on-device claim to the imminent-risk judgment. Not a hard fail.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: A Texan learns what was built, what it costs, what it scored and what is not named. 'Who decided' is thin; no county, adopting body or deadline; the one action is generic flood safety.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The hook is accurate but technical; 2 pays the stake; 3 to 6 are four spec frames; the turn at 7 into 8 lands; the close hands the reader a step.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Plain and on register with Texas vernacular and a strong closing line; some flat kickers; the caption's closing question leans toward a gotcha. No house-rule breaks.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: A fresh subject and palette; the fourth straight institution-release deck with a hero carried through and a 'names no result' turn; the night world close to no. 47's.

one_sentence_fix: Say the flood-risk call is made on the post without a central server, and add c10's central site with its larger model, so the system is not described as having no server.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: An empty band between dek and parts; abstract discs, slabs and a bar; the rail cut off at the right.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Drop the eye and push in so the sensors, enclosure and panel fill the lower half; cut the shield discs; lay the bar in the pool.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A black pickup on black, the gauge over its cab, reading as parked.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Rim the pickup from the lamp, slide the node right, yaw the truck so its headlights sweep up the grade.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A grey bar with one orange donut at feed size, no waterline context.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Pull back to the waterline so three sensors, the water surface and the reflection show.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A lit mid-grey floor under two primitive cylinders.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Kill the floor fill, a tight pool under the bases, backlight the water.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A near-plain grey box reading as clay.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Model glands, a gasket lip and a label plate, rake the lamp low across the lid, add grime streaks.
